title: The Masked Judge
text: A judge in a blank white mask holds court in the street, on a chair of stacked doors, before a crowd that does not breathe. You are accused, he says. Of what, no one will say. The gallows behind him is already strung.

options.label: The smoothest tongue pleads your case, though no one will name the charge.

outcomes.text: Acquitted, and the breathless crowd cheers without a sound.
Guilty. The fine is heavy, and the gallows creaks, disappointed.

options.label: Confess to whatever he likes, and pay the fine before the rope.

outcomes.text: A small fine, and a long stare from the mask, and the feeling of having confessed to something true.

options.label: Tear the mask from the judge, and see who sits in judgement.

outcomes.text: Under the mask, another mask, and the whole court rises at once.
